name: The compiler is never spawned through npx
prose: On Windows npx is npx.cmd and execFile without a shell cannot spawn it. That failed invisibly twice: promote swallowed the ENOENT as a type error, and startup printed "BUILD FAILED" with nothing after it while the lab served defaults from a stale dist.
invariant: The TypeScript entry script runs under the already-executing node binary, with no shell in the path, on every platform.
